review_candidates.description_excerpt: Duties and Responsibilities: Manage on-site installation of heating systems (boilers, pumps, piping networks, radiators, and underfloor heating) in coordination with technical teams. Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, and logistics to secure required equipment, valves, insulation materials, and control components. Support testing, flushing, pressure testing, balancing, commissioning, and final handover of heating systems.
